generation.creativePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG hero illustration for the Home screen of the Biliardino Flutter app
Input images: Image 1 is the exact visual reference. Use only the artwork inside the LEFTMOST phone as the composition and style reference; do not reproduce the phone or interface.
Primary request: Create a polished raster alternative to the Home hero artwork, matching the leftmost phone's energetic foosball composition more closely than the flat SVG version.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with clean alpha; transparent negative-space gaps between the illustrated elements
Subject: exactly four rigid black table-football figures mounted on diagonal black rods, with the largest foreground figure on the left and three progressively smaller figures receding toward the right; one football near the lower center-right; broad sweeping yellow, green, blue, and red ribbons weaving behind and around the figures
Style/medium: crisp premium sports-poster illustration, flat graphic foundation with restrained dimensional shading and subtle warm/yellow rim highlights on the black figures and football, faithful to the leftmost reference; sharp clean edges suitable for a mobile UI asset
Composition/framing: wide approximately 402:276 aspect ratio; edge-to-edge ribbon energy; preserve the left-to-right scale progression, strong foreground silhouette, visible diagonal rods, and prominent football; the illustration must work directly below a separate live wordmark
Color palette: warm black #111111, yellow #FFC700, green #087F3E, blue #0057B8, red #C62828, with small warm ivory highlights only where needed
Text: none
Constraints: actual transparent alpha; illustration only; no wordmark, no letters, no tagline, no button, no icon, no scores, no rows, no navigation, no UI chrome, no phone hardware, no poster footer, no timer, no people, no loose human figures, no stadium, no tournament marks, no official logos, no watermark; do not crop the football; keep each figure visibly attached to a rod
generation.finalBackgroundPrompt:
Use case: precision background replacement for later chroma-key extraction.

Image 1 is the edit target. Replace ONLY the warm ivory background with a perfectly flat, uniform, solid pure magenta background (#FF00FF). The magenta must be continuous behind and between every foreground shape, with no checkerboard, pattern, texture, gradient, vignette, lighting, cast shadow, or variation.

Preserve the foreground artwork exactly: all four black foosball figures, the complete diagonal rod, football, every red/yellow/green/blue ribbon, highlights, shadows, edges, proportions, composition, crop, and small details. Do not redraw, restyle, reposition, resize, simplify, add, or remove any foreground element. Change no foreground detail. The only permitted visual change is ivory background to flat pure magenta.

Output PNG. No text, letters, logo, watermark, UI, button, or device frame.
generation.directTransparencyResult: The built-in direct-transparency edit returned a fully opaque 3-channel PNG with a painted checkerboard (1516x1038, corner RGB 230/233/235) and was rejected.

alphaExtraction.losslessOptimization: ImageMagick metadata strip and PNG compression level 9/filter 5; pixel comparison AE 0

generation.foregroundComparison: Against the retained opaque H2 resized by one pixel to 1516x1038 and restricted to the candidate's >=99% opaque mask, ImageMagick RMSE was 0.0139482. This is evidence of close preservation, not pixel identity or user approval.
